verdicts.cash_burn_subsidy: CFO amounts verified. Attribution dollar-for-dollar to CVNA earnings unsupported; financing cash use does not trace subsidy. Collections include principal and interest, so no normalized CFO add-back claimed.
verdicts.leverage: 20–40x arithmetic broadly reproducible on Gotham definitions but compares asset-backed finance debt with industrial EBITDA. Thin earnings after funding costs are real; securitization recourse limited, not risk-free.
verdicts.instant_900m_loss: Incorrect stock-to-flow inference. Principal-FV gap is not annual loss; FV population also includes recoveries on previously charged-off accounts. Actual 2024 annual mark276.764m; adverse credit394.885m offset discount118.121m.
verdicts.distributions: 351.9m net shareholder withdrawals2022–24 verified, despite500m gross contributions; most net outflow2022. Does not trace subsidy to CVNA.
verdicts.vin_and_origination: Lead worth pursuing; not independently rechecked all34 VINs. Listing history does not necessarily prove ultimate seller; ABS documents allow dealer/BAC originations and acquired loans. No demonstrated mispricing or material total CVNA transfers.
verdicts.gofi: Related-party gains, losses and funding dependence verified. Member contributions not equal DT earnings subsidy. Purchase premium to carryingFV is a real question; market mispricing unproven. Report explicitly describes ML origination system and software expenditures.
verdicts.commissions: 2024/2023 internal7m gaps reconcile to RH/PPM profit-sharing revenue. Cross-company cash-paid versus recognized net commissions and amortization not same measure; full12.3m bridge remains unavailable.
verdicts.silverrock_margin: Margin arithmetic verified; comparison includes different product/entity scope and consolidation entries; does not establish overpayment.
verdicts.consolidation: Negative columns explicitly include consolidating entries; not standalone negative revenues/assets. Detailed BAC-to-group reconciliation unavailable.
verdicts.wholesale_recon: CVNA Note7 wholesale marketplace includes auction and recon; two opposing reconditioning agreements described. Exact residual intercompany reconciliation not complete.
verdicts.auditor: 2025 report signedFeb18 2026 with GrantThornton unqualified FS and ICFR opinions contradicts predicted immediate breakdown; not assurance against all undiscovered misconduct.
